premises.text: A smartwatch app uses consumer watch motion sensors to auto-identify exercises, count reps, and estimate calories, including custom-trained moves
premises.evidence_span: the first and only smartwatch app that automatically identifies your exercises, counts your repetitions, and tracks calories burned

premises.text: Freemium model with trainer routines/feedback plus personalized product offers from fitness journey data

value.text: Frictionless automatic tracking of strength and gym workouts on a smartwatch
value.evidence_span: VemoFit takes the friction out of tracking my workouts

automatically identifies your exercises, counts your repetitions, and tracks calories burned
